title: Prove sharp geometric convergence of the projection recurrence (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Prove a sharp geometric convergence bound for the unstrengthened block-four projection recurrence:

`2^(-m) < T_m - 439277/149175 < 2^(1-m)` for every integer `m >= 5`.

The new ingredients are an exact four-mode representation of the entire normalized profile and a uniform two-step transfer bound controlling both infinite parity tails. This improves the previously stated `O(1/m)` convergence rate to matching upper and lower bounds of order `2^(-m)`. The mode sequences remain recursively defined; no elementary closed form is claimed.

The package also obtains strict monotonicity and the unattained infimum, but **those are credited shared corollaries, not the additional contribution**: JoyboyBrian's concurrent #5184 proves them by a different weighted-order method. The exact limit itself is Nick Petalas's #5151 theorem, explicitly cited as a mathematical dependency.

This is a scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. It does not certify the inherited hook ranks, a physical engine, dirty restoration, complete recursive costs, a new kappa, or a selected-frontier change. Independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/projection-geometric-tail
python3.12 -I -X dev -W error -B research/projection-geometric-tail/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -X dev -W error -B research/projection-geometric-tail/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/projection-geometric-tail --check-source-history
```

All pass at the contribution head. Normal and optimized output agree byte-for-byte with `RESULT.json`. Evidence includes 1,215 whole-profile equalities through block 48, 172 scalar recurrence identities, 172 scaled-state identities, the symbolic polynomial remainder identity, 49 finite fixtures for the uniform estimates, and exact tail checkpoints at 32 and 33. Ten controls reject wrong recurrence terms, coefficients, parameter domains, bounds, involution sign, tail budget/parity, limit and an invalid all-seed monotonicity extension.

The universal claims rely on the written operator inequalities and summable infinite-tail argument, not extrapolation from those finite checks. The exact limit is a credited dependency, not an independently audited predecessor theorem.

Committed-byte/source-history checks and official seven-file export integrity pass. Both direct modes also pass from a read-only export with Git absent from `PATH`; outputs match `RESULT.json` and all eight files including the receipt retain identical hashes. Selected-baseline source/metadata orientation passed; no broad historical scientific replay was run. Both hosted jobs passed at this exact head in [Registered research packages run 39951804385](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39951804385): planning and the focused package replay. Automated CI does not establish independent scientific acceptance.

## Open next questions

The README records two bounded follow-ups: exact leading parity constants or elementary/q-series expressions for the modes, and classification of monotone seed profiles. Start with the fixed-operator second-order recurrence; equality cases in the seed cone remain a blocker. No follow-up is reserved by this PR.
